latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of resume-tailor skill.

- Transforms a generic resume into a tailored application package (custom resume + cover letter) based on a specific job description.
- Guides users through gathering required inputs: resume, job description, and preferences.
- Analyzes the job description to identify keywords, required skills, and company values.
- Rewrites resumes to prioritize relevance, keywords, and measurable achievements; trims unrelated content.
- Generates a concise, personalized cover letter matching the tone and requirements of the target role/company.
- Provides a gap analysis and quick interview prep tips alongside the tailored documents.
